native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 'initial', 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'servo1': '0 degrees', 'servo2': '0 degrees'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. After power-on or reset, both servos are at 0 degrees and the LED is off.'}

test2: {'time': 'after 2 seconds', 'state': {'led1': 'on', 'servo1': '90 degrees', 'servo2': '0 degrees'}, 'description': 'After pressing btn1, servo1 rotates to 90 degrees and the LED turns on. This state is maintained for at least 2 seconds.'}

test3: {'time': 'after 2.5 seconds', 'state': {'led1': 'on', 'servo1': '0 degrees', 'servo2': '0 degrees'}, 'description': 'After pressing btn2 while btn1 was already pressed, both servos return to 0 degrees and the LED flashes at 0.25 Hz (on for 2 seconds, off for 2 seconds). The test checks that the LED is on and both servos are at 0 degrees.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
test_origin: manual_requirement_derived_supplement; retained original test plan is unchanged
